staticText: Private exam and registration deadline planner. Treat each source card according to its explicit date meaning: registration deadline, official timetable opening, examination window, or candidate-selected first paper. Never imply that a national timetable opening is every candidate’s first paper. Ask the user to confirm their exact paper date, time, venue, subject entry, permitted materials, and registration status with the linked official authority or school. Entries stay in the browser session unless the user explicitly chooses local device storage; sharing must remain route-only and must not expose names or dates.
